notes.title: This Is No Cave launches Oct 17
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="cKo0RC5BVyc;full"][/previewyoutube]
Release date: Oct 17 (CEST)!
v1.0 includes
• 30 handcrafted levels (from tight sprints to set-piece chases)
• 4-player couch co-op (chaotic revives & clutch saves)
• Endless roguelite mode with evolving perks

Steam Fest feedback improved movement feel, worm telegraphing, and level readability — thank you!
If you like what you see, add the game to your wishlist. See you in the caverns on Oct 17.

notes.title: The space worm got creepier
notes.content:
Major Updates

Reworked Boss:

Space worm now screams.
Space worm now make screen shakes.
Space worm now generate rock particles in its wake.
Space worm now brings shadow upon its surrounding.
Made space worm AI less predictable.


Minor Updates

You can now choose the jump direction while running.
Grappling hook now has a minimum velocity.
Improved tutorials visuals.


Fixes

Fixed an issue where chinese, japanese and korean nicknames would not appear in leaderboard.
Fixed an issue where some hook points would not be accessible because of a checkpoint between them and the player.

notes.title: The bonus update
notes.content:
Major Updates

Reworked Bonuses:

Placed all bonuses at better spots.
Made sure bonuses can be picked up even in hardcore mode.
Reduced number of bonuses to 3 per level.


Minor Updates

Added Russian language Support (Thank you u/Jamato-sUn).
Greatly improved performances when boss is on screen.
Removed the frame cap.
Reduced time slow factor when entering a gas bulb.
Added a time slow when tutorial text appears on screen.


Fixes

Fixed an issue where difficulty would not update correctly in settings.
Fixed an issue where pause menu would fail to appear.
Fixed an issue where animations would be stuck in one state.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest. Update
notes.content:
Major Updates

Reworked Controls:

Hooking and swinging is now performed with right click.
The grappling hook will attach to the closest hook point from the cursor, eliminating the need for precise aiming.
Pulling the rope while swinging is now done using left click.

Reworked Gas Bulbs (or black holes depending on who you ask):

Players will slow down when entering them.
Trajectory is now more coherent when bursting.
Adjusted the duration during which players can break walls after exploding a gas bulb.

Added 3 Difficulty Levels: Chill, Speedrunner, and Hardcore.


Minor Updates

Added Multilingual Support: Game is now available in French, German, and Spanish.
Reworked Tutorial: Added gamepad indications and improved explanations on how to play.
Set Framerate to 120FPS: Performance enhancements.
Adapted the Game to Wide Screen Resolutions: The game now supports wide screens.
Added a Suicide Button: Allows for quick restart.
Set Up Pause Menu on Escape Press: Easy access to the pause menu.


Fixes

Fixed an issue where players would appear multiple times in the leaderboard.
Fixed an issue where the leaderboard would not appear.
Fixed an issue where nicknames would be truncated to 8 characters.
Fixed an issue where the life bar would display bubbles when none were configured.
Fixed an issue on the endless level where entire level chunks would disappear.
Fixed various UI issues.
Added UI controller support.
